# sidecar.write_sidecar_metadata { #healpyxel.sidecar.write_sidecar_metadata }

```python
sidecar.write_sidecar_metadata(
    output_path,
    input_path,
    nside,
    mode,
    lon_convention,
    ncores,
    args,
    derived_from_parent=None,
)
```

Write sidecar processing metadata to a JSON companion file.

Creates a ``.meta.json`` file alongside the sidecar parquet file with
complete processing parameters, HEALPix configuration, and provenance
information. When the sidecar is derived from a higher-nside computation
via bit-shift aggregation, the parent nside is recorded.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                | Type               | Description                                                                                                                 | Default    |
|---------------------|--------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| output_path         | Path               | Path to the sidecar parquet file.                                                                                           | _required_ |
| input_path          | Path               | Path to the source input file.                                                                                              | _required_ |
| nside               | int                | HEALPix nside parameter.                                                                                                    | _required_ |
| mode                | str                | Assignment mode: ``'strict'`` or ``'fuzzy'``.                                                                               | _required_ |
| lon_convention      | str                | Longitude convention used: ``'0_360'`` or ``'minus_plus180'``.                                                              | _required_ |
| ncores              | int                | Number of Dask worker cores used.                                                                                           | _required_ |
| args                | argparse.Namespace | Parsed command-line arguments (for recording PSF settings, etc.).                                                           | _required_ |
| derived_from_parent | int or None        | If set, this sidecar was derived from a higher-nside sidecar via NEST bit-shift aggregation. The value is the parent nside. | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                       |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------|
|        | Path   | Path to the written ``.meta.json`` metadata file. |
